instruction.name: xvmsknz.b
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, for each 8-bit element in `a`, set the bit at that element's index within the lane to one if the element is non-zero, otherwise zero; the remaining bits of the lane are zero.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvmsknz.b $xr0, $xr8; xvmsknz.b $xr1, $xr9; xvmsknz.b $xr2, $xr10; xvmsknz.b $xr3, $xr11; xvmsknz.b $xr4, $xr12; xvmsknz.b $xr5, $xr13; xvmsknz.b $xr6, $xr14; xvmsknz.b $xr7, $xr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvmsknz.b $xr0, $xr8; xvmsknz.b $xr1, $xr9; xvmsknz.b $xr2, $xr10; xvmsknz.b $xr3, $xr11; xvmsknz.b $xr4, $xr12; xvmsknz.b $xr5, $xr13; xvmsknz.b $xr6, $xr14; xvmsknz.b $xr7, $xr15'
